blocks.text: Roaming through the mall after hitting a few errands almost always leads to that inevitable moment where you start eyeing a single food stall you pass. And most of the time, we don’t want anything but finding a quiet table and a solid snack to make your day out a little bit better. Pulling up your SM Malls Online app while looking for a perfect seat is probably the easiest way to score a quick upgrade without overthinking your spending. Between seasonal menu drops and low key weekday discounts, there are plenty of sweet little options waiting to be claimed. Here’s […]...
